$comment: Definitive list of values usable in a course's pillar frontmatter field. Drives the site's nav submenu under each audience. scripts/validate.js checks every course's pillar exists here.

pillars.name: Cross-Cutting Themes
pillars.description: Risks and disciplines that run through every pillar and every sector rather than belonging to one — e.g. operational resilience, sustainable finance, consumer protection, cross-border supervision, data & technology infrastructure.

pillars.name: Core Regulatory-Function Pillars
pillars.description: The substantive regulatory functions a supervisory authority performs, regardless of sector — governance, policy-making, authorisation, supervision, enforcement, financial crime, crisis management, capability building.

pillars.name: Generic Supervisory Skills
pillars.description: Skills that let regulatory staff function effectively across every pillar and sector — management, communication, judgement, and technology skills not tied to a particular financial sector.

pillars.name: Sector Programmes
pillars.description: Technical, subject-matter training for supervising particular parts of the financial sector (banking, insurance, investment funds, payments, pensions, etc.) and specialist cross-sector technical themes (digital assets, AI, sustainable finance, cybersecurity, SupTech).
